prompt: The client wants to enter the European country where it is easiest to win share. Which takeaway matters most?

options.text: Spain is the most fragmented, with 45% outside the top two
options.feedback: Right. In Spain no player has more than 30% and the tail holds 45%; France's leader has 60%.

options.text: Germany's top two players are close, at 35% and 30%
options.feedback: True, but together they hold 65%, more than Spain's top two (55%). Spain is easier to break into.

options.text: France has a long tail of small players
options.feedback: France's 'all others' is only 15%; its leader holds 60%.

options.text: Spanish shoppers are more open to foreign brands
options.feedback: The chart shows market shares, not shopper attitudes. That may be true, but nothing here supports it.

explanation: In Spain no player has more than 30% and the tail holds 45%; France's leader has 60%.

extras.proof: In Spain no player has more than 30% and the tail holds 45%; France's leader has 60%.
